implementation_notes: Implemented env-tunable character ceilings for both review-seat and specialist prompts, mirroring the _trim_synthesis_prompt pattern. Key changes: (1) review_seat.py: Added _REVIEW_INSTRUCTION_HEADER and _REVIEW_FINDING_SCHEMA protected markers, _trim_review_seat_user with staged trimming (repo_context first, then diff), marker reservation in diff-trim step. (2) specialist_invocations.py: Added marker_reservation=80 to overflow calculation in Layer 2 truncation. (3) Both modules export env var defaults (GUARDKIT_REVIEW_SEAT_MAX_CHARS=300000, GUARDKIT_SPECIALIST_PROMPT_MAX_CHARS=300000). Debugging: Fixed test_trims_repo_context_before_diff by lowering budget from 250k to 220k (original budget was above total message size, preventing truncation from triggering). Fixed truncation marker assertion from '[...truncated' to 'truncated' to match actual marker syntax.
concerns: The marker_reservation values (100 for diff, 80 for specialist) were tuned empirically. If LLM providers add longer headers/footers to their responses, these may need adjustment.
The staged trimming approach (repo_context before diff) is deterministic but may produce suboptimal context preservation in edge cases where the diff is the more valuable section.
